The steps below describe the onboarding journey: any 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:64333f73ed9cdae11bd768206b42389b: entity type goes through Data Collection and Registration Record Creation, Certificate Issuance and, where it is also a notified entity, Notification and Publication; the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f27280714d78af20f4c381aae43bb27e: goes through Certificate Issuance for its Sign/Seal Certificate and Notification and Publication, without a registration record.

docs.title: Data Collection and Registration Record Creation
docs.text:
This step produces the registration record for a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2413d7d11e5fa13c4615490fdc209e34:.

The entity submits its registration data through the Onboarding UI, which forwards the request to the Registration Service (6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b6e06270699e905f0ca82028d19e9fbb:<__None__>).

Within APTITUDE, registration SHALL be restricted to APTITUDE Partners, and the Onboarding System SHALL enforce this restriction [ONBOARD-REG-01]. This replaces the identity proofing of [ETSI TS 119 461] and the verification duties of [CIR 2025/848, Article 6] (REGISTRAR-REG-04 to REGISTRAR-REG-07, not restated here). The mechanism by which participation is established, for example a pre-provisioned list of participants, or a membership check, is an implementation choice; a non-participant SHALL NOT be registered, and onboarding SHALL NOT proceed.

On successful verification, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:92af804d606ad67853ea19dd78c9ec07:<__None__> SHALL create the record through the common 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2586955f5c41172716cfecb38ca63113:<__None__> write API (POST /wrp, see Common Register API), using a body conforming to the WalletRelyingParty schema of Register Data Schema, and SHALL set the registration status to active. Write access to the API SHALL be authenticated and restricted to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a1eaab67d2c6dbbdb79b7f81f32f80b5:<__None__> [ONBOARD-REG-02]; the concrete credential mechanism (for example a bearer token or mutual TLS) is an implementation choice. When published or queried, the record is electronically signed/sealed by or on behalf of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ac831b48a2c4a3bcbe839948a4ae93d7:<__None__> (REGISTER-PUB-05).

docs.title: Certificate Issuance
docs.text:
This step issues the applicable certificates for an operational entity. For a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:088ca2d06b17d4bd526a9d140097c9bb:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:61fc6f19dbc6246de67ad523d26cf7bf: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0fff2da5c12b8bfd570f0832304646f7: issuance starts once its registration record is active; a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7ced79788e7c7db2eaa5b2d6a10e0026: requests its Sign/Seal Certificate without a registration record.

The request/issuance protocol is an implementation choice (for example ACME, EST, or a manual exchange); the enrolment SHOULD include a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:127d4aa02890eace0396866d6ca8044f: of the private key corresponding to the certified public key, a property inherited from the certificate-policy framework underlying [ETSI TS 119 411-8]. The verifications below apply regardless of the protocol.

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f282bbb1da1ca902e66ed623f2f3c966:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:285023942866bc78aed79fd9607ed9a2: issues one or more 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:13614df0eee65a132e256d6e57845d50:, whose content and format are defined in Wallet-Relying Party Access Certificate. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b87d9a973ba7f58ba07deb25ad74ee60: receives a separate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a78c6af038347f95a372a6975abf6b9c: for each of its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:105af92248b280bb9c59507fc8fb8f83: (Reg_10a). At issuance time it SHALL verify that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b6addcf3e30cdef2fc0a924ed07cb707: has an active registration status and that the certificate information is consistent with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2696aa90b4c9ce9a68aff24863b28d53:<__None__> (requirement PROVIDER-WRPAC-01 in Register, from [CIR 2025/848, Annex IV 3(c)]); its attributes are derived from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a727970494259130a648b5bd79d91aab:<__None__> information ([ETSI TS 119 475, Clause 5.1.2]). If the registration is not active or the data are inconsistent, the Provider SHALL refuse to issue the certificate.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:214d00b421ac44568266b9da226a5225:. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:87884dada61edbc7893e77cf76809b2f: issues a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ce7579f89fd786bf1be9c6c0dcc537ae:, whose content and format are defined in Wallet-Relying Party Registration Certificate. At issuance time it SHALL verify the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b094642a63a57507381c74bda90dc0ca:<__None__> status, the consistency with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:01c4ff0bf9aef289874d0d205b86ef86:<__None__> information, and the validity of the corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6960212cb23725eff94b5716721e0474: when relevant (requirement PROVIDER-WRPRC-02 in Register, from [CIR 2025/848, Annex V 3(c)]). The same failure handling applies.
  • Sign/Seal Certificate. The Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Service realises the Provider of Sign/Seal Certificates role and issues the applicable certificate to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c28d08b5c4811a845273cd0f5922493c:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c7ea2dc7fe68206a157ea07388a54af5:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fcc87485e71c230251e6d7846bba6496:, for signing or sealing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a956e3fc506cc3d8052ac81e0269988f:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9ec49cda2c08d80a5b831451dbda9a9c:, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1227c2bc992d7cc2f34814e0418b0a21:, respectively. Its content and format SHALL conform to the applicable Entity Sign/Seal Certificate Profile. The issued certificate is an end-entity certificate, distinct from the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cad819551ebfeba8f3da49536df808bc:<__None__> published in the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:61f315d6bcc5737a4a35f23e25b6e385:; its certificate chain SHALL terminate at that trust anchor.

    APTITUDE Implementation Choice

    In the normative baseline, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bd36be754c8020e0e4c347068490335c: is created during the registration process by a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6fc6580264d0aa79bdee362373572fb3: associated to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5b1883cea5a8551bd483dcbbfa0dce2c:<__None__> (RPRC_09, RPRC_13), and no certificate-based request step is described. The presentation of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6b09767de6d422b12ea94a83440fe28c: when requesting the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a5f40574f144585a7f0396085683538d:, shown in the Detailed flow, is therefore an APTITUDE-specific design choice, which gives the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1db485ee31b9fa92e5f56ec796438c31: direct evidence for the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f02e5f9efa90583ee83f87558beae569: validity verification required by PROVIDER-WRPRC-02.

    Identity proofing is not repeated here; it is performed by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:76dc53aa699a17f17551f5983b71f275:<__None__> at Data Collection and Registration Record Creation. After issuance, the entity deploys each 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b9fb33135e4a7d81158cb5987974cfb4: at the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0a5df1cb84f6ec6468c7ff3ddf435cdc:<__None__> for which it was issued (Reg_10a), provides its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:857c001aff82d460af900e2816013ad3: to its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e8a0dc8495be88d8c7079ad2922e4b84: or service supply points and, for an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e699b71b89f5641c66dc27878cab4306:, includes it in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:932f3c433d19d13eaccea1b27ec39265:<__None__> used at issuance (RPRC_10, RPRC_14, RPRC_22). A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88e5cd8b9dbe44608d17c4ddd9769274: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f59e141f1f5448018de8199e59f3aca2: deploys its Sign/Seal Certificate at the service supply point that signs or seals 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:15e5584866845571538cd432a141fe8a: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bbbb1de6a2fbfa46e0ebae5ba3db4d83:; a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5430cb04d5cf141c4c73bfdec44bcbc1: deploys it at the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e20c94c8bcfbaa6208f75152bca8d047:<__None__> service that signs or seals 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7504bc4d83501579fea7df935b344562:.

docs.title: Notification and Publication
docs.text:
This step publishes a notified entity, together with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9235c844778e07576f2c9842cce6c3bd:<__None__> of the technical component it operates, in the appropriate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ee41c287660b33be1245c6349af5b8fa:. 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b3e3b31f3fe3dc5c78d6a530762318ad: is a separate, Member State level process ([CIR 2024/2980]) and is not a duty of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:773405881cf149a5f7bed978f9e3fecc:<__None__>. Within APTITUDE, the Member State to European Commission notification act SHALL be mocked by the Publication Service, triggered by the Onboarding UI, while the signing and publication of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:58b1301ada94475af9da0f29ad24443c: SHALL follow the normative framework [ONBOARD-PUB-01].

For a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a00c1aa709981740e1d1222cdc461508:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8185daf30c0a86d3b2878adc15e49f87:, or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:35570d6c6ff7e2cdd48d1c9451c795b0:, the applicable Sign/Seal Certificate SHALL be issued before the notification data is submitted. The Sign/Seal Certificate is the notified entity's end-entity certificate and is distinct from both the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1b202e6bf5af76abf62871edf9c6eccc:<__None__> published in the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e748977a7b424707ced39faa05853a83: and the certificate used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e36bffaf40ba5d0f21db7ec4ad4d717f: to sign the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:43a02c64cdea0d10dcd5f44c237a8bd9:.

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f768e166927223901bb1bdfee14d98b0: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:565b612c156a4975cb37af894681409e: are added to the respective 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e0e6c2e2c6afecbad0bce5f866c9b486:.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:871f6da7a8e2fa71d6b494c390223a0f: follow a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1b3e835690ea6133ea3000f1600b4b12:-only path, with no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b953b6a241601afd4e8bccd0508a5fdc:<__None__> record, no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cd9f846c9e41d5546e13f10aa5ea4457:, and no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9bccfdd0ac8fb06be549813646bb2644:; their Sign/Seal Certificates are issued before their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6cc889e2f0c2ab9716429396d7e91589:<__None__> is published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5d1278f545cfa63095afa3bec410b09c: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9094096f9c836e063b3c5567e9ffc526:;
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e01f4b46a2d7b135b0e1bbb63e478123: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f25f770f668c018254aff79eebd83fd9: require no 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9baf2eafefbbbbb7c967f03512d5da5d: entry, as trust in it is anchored through the signed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:dd1524f9151606bc7874d70baa128e65:<__None__> and its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:44c3302931820d42872a7d70f312176e:.

    Note

    The Sign/Seal Certificate issued to a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f2e7cb9a279e016d3ec266fd0e592023: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cd6ec573183f3b5c23329dd3a0e90188: is the end-entity certificate with which its service supply point signs or seals 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:66f48a0b6b5c66552498967e6738fae4: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7c6839788416de64ebd6c9da9b03c438:; for a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0625e20f57d8a13bddb49f577ffaa96f: it is the certificate used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c03cbf6027b3a7b139bb205f03d28b23:<__None__> to sign or seal 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:251075cfd7796adbf0b8edf5540f7257:. The corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6ec36a9e45a99df5e80c0038fc8357f4:<__None__> published in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88c4f3aec7e182b0f735900ef9e84206: is the CA certificate at which the Sign/Seal Certificate chain terminates. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a82b2dd94f46198e57b623289775a70b: entry therefore binds the organisational entity to the technical component that operates at runtime.

    On failure, if publication does not complete, a notified entity MAY already hold its issued Sign/Seal Certificate and, where it is a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:12e7a935b796994ddfdca32e157466d6:, have an active registration record and hold its 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c5d94ff785fadfd1c38d5efeb88eae22: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0658a86f3b8af05b5498f7d9e1fc5e16:, but not yet be present in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:24e5911a52ef8b72cbb76ed6690ac4fc:. The issued certificate and registration record alone do not make the entity trusted by 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1c20ee0c9a8ce600232853a619cbf283: until the entry is published.

docs.title: Detailed Flow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant E as Operational Entity
    participant UI as Onboarding UI
    participant RegServ as Registration Service
    participant Register as WRP Register
    participant ACServ as WRPAC Issuance Service
    participant RCServ as WRPRC Issuance Service
    participant SSCServ as Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance Service
    participant PubServ as Publication Service
    participant TL as LoTE

    E->>UI: submit onboarding data and cryptographic material
    alt entity registers (any WRP)
        UI->>RegServ: create registration (registration data + crypto material)
        RegServ->>RegServ: ensure entity is an APTITUDE participant (mocked proofing)
        RegServ<<->>Register: write data
        RegServ-->>UI: response with status active
        UI->>ACServ: request WRPAC
        ACServ->>RegServ: request verification of active status and consistency
        RegServ<<->>Register: get data
        RegServ-->>ACServ: response with active status
        ACServ->>ACServ: check data consistency
        ACServ-->>UI: WRPAC
        UI-->>E: provide WRPAC
        E->>UI: request WRPRC (with WRPAC)
        UI->>RCServ: request WRPRC
        RCServ->>RCServ: check WRPAC validity (when relevant)
        RCServ->>RegServ: request verification of active status and consistency
        RegServ<<->>Register: get data
        RegServ-->>RCServ: response with active status
        RCServ->>RCServ: check data consistency
        RCServ-->>UI: WRPRC
        UI-->>E: provide WRPRC
        opt PID / PuB-EAA / QEAA / EAA Providers
            E->>UI: request Sign/Seal Certificate
            UI->>SSCServ: request Sign/Seal Certificate (with cryptographic material)
            SSCServ->>RegServ: request verification of active status and consistency
            RegServ<<->>Register: get data
            RegServ-->>SSCServ: response with active status
            SSCServ->>SSCServ: check data and applicable certificate profile
            SSCServ-->>UI: Sign/Seal Certificate
            UI-->>E: provide Sign/Seal Certificate
            UI->>PubServ: submit notifiable data
            PubServ<<->>TL: publish to applicable LoTE
            PubServ-->>UI: entry successfully created
            UI-->>E: publication confirmed
        end
    else Wallet Providers
        E->>UI: request Sign/Seal Certificate
        UI->>SSCServ: request Sign/Seal Certificate (with cryptographic material)
        SSCServ->>SSCServ: check request and applicable certificate profile
        SSCServ-->>UI: Sign/Seal Certificate
        UI-->>E: provide Sign/Seal Certificate
        UI->>PubServ: submit notifiable data
        PubServ<<->>TL: publish to Wallet Providers LoTE
        PubServ-->>UI: entry successfully created
        UI-->>E: publication confirmed
    end

docs.title: Connection to Lifecycle Management
docs.text:
Onboarding is the first phase of the lifecycle of an entity and of the artifacts produced for it. This subsection summarises how onboarding connects to the Trust Management Process and distinguishes the lifecycle of registered entities from that of notified entities.

For entities that are registered in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3807b8abfa1ba56c3cb210a5465b7061:<__None__>, the registration record follows the status model below.

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Active: onboarding completed
    Active --> Active: update of registration data
    Active --> Cancelled: cancellation
    Cancelled --> [*]
  • Update. A change to the registration data triggers the corresponding update of the dependent artifacts. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f5eb55fc6b1e5621b7e52dd19df8bd3e: and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bcc85dfbb2f36cfbb9ce01d93db29f69: SHALL monitor the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f8618c506005020b87919f3f84395b00:<__None__> and reissue or revoke the affected 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4da36d64f6830a9c83cf20f42e088fbf: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a74dba192f5058e2708eddd5898b4833: when the change requires it (requirements PROVIDER-WRPAC-02 and PROVIDER-WRPRC-03 in Register), and the corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ed2087bb81ff87ae874506bbd1083243: entry is updated where applicable.
  • Cancellation / De-onboarding. Setting the registration status to cancelled (or deleting the record) triggers the revocation of any dependent 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b7ac4ad228f18e9190834ea82b8158ae: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6d1d1d2c3f136be2aef46e0f5e9bd519: by the respective providers. The revocation mechanisms (6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f4ffa4f885fe191497a39db3f656c7b5: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:87ef7d1eb09d074714836927d5582a86: for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:580526b1a147c97c2bb566d8fc4db15e:; 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:67e0f3ecec3dd22d1f7a5f78e30872a9: for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b2cff30524fa4aac5de95f14ed12e297:) are defined in Revocation Mechanisms.

    These actions SHALL act on the organisational entity, that is its registration and the certificates issued to it, and not on the technical product it operates [ONBOARD-LC-02]. The certification lifecycle of the technical product, in particular the certification of a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:07502edcda89f590ea1540ba81f1d5fb:<__None__>, is a separate process, out of scope of this document. A change to that certification that does not affect the entity's eligibility SHALL be reflected as a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:85462f20831541a1a49b29c864c8bebf: update and SHALL NOT, by itself, be treated as de-onboarding. A change that makes the entity no longer eligible SHALL instead lead to its cancellation, whose effect on the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:134fb4c5c4a59345509167f2f9ade619: is defined by ONBOARD-LC-01 [ONBOARD-LC-03].

    The lifecycle of entities that are only notified is governed by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:87e3cf6a763e8600eeaf3d4ed73c40f1: framework ([CIR 2024/2980]). The entity is published when notified, and upon cancellation it stops being trusted (ARF GenNot_05). For the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:36bad196433c4e13068437d26757dcbc:, a cancellation additionally requires the revocation of all its valid 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c806952792703cfc5bbbe213a59291a4: (ARF WPNot_06). The same applies to the other notified entities published in their 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cfbae16c355c24a32665f52b5cbed1e4:.

    How stops being trusted is represented depends on the list type, and APTITUDE adopts the representation already supported by each format. The PuB-EAA Provider 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ac6ea81ef5e88047752074fe26b4ea0e: carries an explicit per-entry status, which on cancellation SHALL be set to withdrawn or invalid; the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5c7e285dceb7ff16b591ba85332cd35c:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0acd09eb258a9b47f761a4f21ae524f0:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0d276ae24abc047cc6004807cc406bc5:, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f8d07c18c2eca54c1bf784a8249e68dd:, and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9620f6a9a900437a62b7abfc54564d32:<__None__> 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1b94af0d1cf1b7e25b2c92aceae7b3fb: carry no per-entry status (per [ETSI TS 119 602], ServiceStatus and the service history are not used for these types), so for them a cancelled entity SHALL be reflected by removing the entry [ONBOARD-LC-01]. The broader lifecycle of notified entities belongs to the Trust Management Process.

    Finally, the artifacts produced by onboarding are consumed in the trust evaluation processes. The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ed531dd07c89d17b641f917ab0b0a7cd: is used in the Authentication Process, Sign/Seal Certificates are used in the Sign/Seal Validation Process, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1108943840b6690ce912b336f4c2e27b: and the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1e3e4f0a66cc6099fc7f644578e7788b:<__None__> are used in the Authorization Process, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:aaac2eedce4c9f07409731640b064c75: 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:15145928a823315e5fba82b7a58cc246: are used in the Trust Anchor Validation Process, and certificate revocation is covered by Revocation Mechanisms.

docs.title: Trust Architecture
docs.text: This section defines the APTITUDE Trust Architecture, including all components that enable the functional trust evaluation mechanisms used within the APTITUDE ecosystem. It first identifies the entities involved in the Large Scale Pilot, then describes the infrastructure through which APTITUDE WP2 establishes their trust, and finally introduces the Onboarding System that renders those entities operational and recognizable within the ecosystem.

docs.title: Entities
docs.text:
The APTITUDE Large Scale Pilot implement business use cases that exercise interactions within the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:456e6f8df1e4348df42e71bd71ad51a1:<__None__> ecosystem. As a result, the roles defined by that ecosystem remain applicable, while the supporting trust infrastructure is realized specifically within the APTITUDE boundaries. docs.title: Trust Infrastructure
docs.text:
The APTITUDE Large Scale Pilot does not deploy the full-stack Member State and European Commission infrastructure assumed by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:59503ca3e7f9aff622ea4bb7194f10c3:<__None__> framework. For piloting purposes, APTITUDE WP2 operates the corresponding capabilities regarding registration, certificate issuance, and publication of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:75a858788ba3ef22a5d5fc649dc51de2:. Together, these capabilities establish the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:22ab72ea0d34765ea2aa02217193fbee: and trust artifacts used by the Trust Evaluation Processes.

The trust infrastructure employed for APTITUDE consists of:

  • The APTITUDE 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:92938c5a33c220f2535f0d0390fcaff9:, which issues and manages the X.509 certificates required by the ecosystem.
  • The Registration Service and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:214ceefa6a40b17ffcca4ffdba1f0dad:<__None__>, which record the identity, role, and authorization information of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a795822b3a464a479ad13d4eb83bb27d:.
  • The Certificate Issuance Services, which issue and manage 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2c620bb983448011bc72a5465a7a1799: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:eb52675fc6839c5bd629f5a74b96ae2d: during onboarding. The PKI also issues and manages the Entity Sign/Seal Certificates used by entities.
  • The Publication Service, which signs and publishes the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2e6ce497871f37cdb0110ea5745c9146:.
  • The Onboarding UI, which coordinates these services for each entity requesting onboarding.

docs.title: Trust Service Overview
docs.text:
The trust infrastructure capabilities are exposed through the APTITUDE Onboarding System. In this specification, Onboarding System denotes the aggregate logical system, while Service denotes one of its constituent components (Registration, WRPAC Issuance, WRPRC Issuance, Sign/Seal Certificate Issuance or Publication).

The Onboarding System operates on a trust infrastructure whose entities are established and whose 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3e478bc26e62048b0510006ab6772396: are published before operational entity onboarding starts. Within APTITUDE, this one-time prerequisite is established out of band with no pilot software and is not part of the recurring onboarding flow. The recurring process enables APTITUDE operational entities to obtain the trust artifacts required for interactions within the ecosystem. Its detailed inputs, outputs, and entity-specific paths are defined in Onboarding Process.

The Onboarding UI is the APTITUDE-specific orchestrator and single point of contact for an entity requesting onboarding. It collects the submitted data and SHALL trigger the applicable stages in order: registration, certificate issuance, and, where applicable, publication or update of the relevant 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6fc2a451d20cde50ad50e16ab616252a: entry:

  1. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:06a5492eebe83f12dddbc3b7dc6d64a7: submits its registration data to the Registration Service. Within APTITUDE, registration SHALL be restricted to APTITUDE Partners; the Registration Service SHALL otherwise rely on the submitted self-declaration and SHALL NOT perform the identity proofing defined in [ETSI TS 119 461] or [CIR 2025/848, Article 6]. After successful verification, the Registration Service creates an active record in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cbfb91bd2b5c08571ff292d2e68bf590:.
  2. After the registration record is active, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bb66d046d97c7f6c013bf5524672fb23: requests the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5069b0e86612241f53d481509ef4e831: and 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:30f7d3d1e7e28e6d1be30eb6726e268a:. The certificate issuance stage also covers Sign/Seal Certificates where applicable.
  3. A notified 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:17bef0a4fbb7c3ab66e9acb9ff96bb9a: submits its notifiable data, after certificate issuance, to the Publication Service, which creates or updates the applicable 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:853b1e12211f44eb1efb6c84cc5f64f4: entry. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:285aa43d1f03977902dca52e5f6f49a1: follows a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e518e796d44caafe575569a36506c309:-only path with respect to registration and WRP certificates: it bypasses those stages, obtains its Sign/Seal Certificate, and then submits its notifiable data to the Publication Service.
  4. A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:37e4cd072567d42af9c9e115697b17ee: or 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:32f939d38bb6768890f9e89be2e0c5be: completes onboarding after certificate issuance and does not require a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7a85a7613ad63ad8906021b726124ea5: entry; trust in it is anchored through the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a04234f61a67cc3fc81caa0fc13da385:.

    The figure below provides a logical overview rather than a deployment architecture. The notification data store is an internal detail of the Onboarding Process and is not represented here. The component responsibilities, prerequisites, inputs, outputs, and entity-specific paths are specified in Onboarding Process.

docs.title: X.509 Certificate Profile
docs.text:
This section defines a general X.509 Certificate Profile, establishing the syntax, semantics and encoding requirements for X.509 certificates based on [RFC 5280] and [ETSI EN 319 412].

Each X.509 certificate defined in this specification SHALL conform to the requirements of this section unless explicitly stated otherwise.

In accordance with [RFC 5280, Section 4], the Certificate ASN.1 structure consists of a SEQUENCE composed of the following fields:

Field Type Presence Description Reference in [RFC 5280] tbsCertificate SEQUENCE REQUIRED Contains the names of the subject and issuer, a public key associated with the subject, a validity period, and other associated information. Section 4.1.1.1 signatureAlgorithm SEQUENCE REQUIRED Contains the identifier for the cryptographic algorithm used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:543b1fa82fcdef83fdf203e8e456a332: to sign the certificate. Section 4.1.1.2 signatureValue BIT STRING REQUIRED Contains a digital signature computed upon the ASN.1 DER encoded tbsCertificate. Section 4.1.1.3

Note

The rest of the section details the content of the tbsCertificate field only. For additional information on the signatureAlgorithm and signatureValue fields, refer to [RFC 5280].

The tbsCertificate field SHALL contain a TBSCertificate structure conforming to [RFC 5280, Section 4.1.2]. The following table details the certificate fields for the profile specified in this document, including presence requirements, syntax types, descriptions, and corresponding references in [RFC 5280]. Individual certificate profiles MAY provide additional contextual notes for these fields, but SHALL NOT alter the presence requirements specified herein.

Field Type Presence Description Reference in [RFC 5280] version INTEGER REQUIRED Describes the version of the encoded certificate. For this profile, it SHALL be version 3 (value 2). Section 4.1.2.1 serialNumber INTEGER REQUIRED Represents the serial number of the certificate. Section 4.1.2.2 signature SEQUENCE REQUIRED Contains the algorithm identifier for the algorithm used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0f7accae72d32d8d16ddd603c7056daa: to sign the certificate. The signature algorithm SHOULD be selected according to [ETSI TS 119 312], but MAY be superseded by national recommendations. Section 4.1.2.3, Section 4.1.1.2 issuer CHOICE REQUIRED Identifies the entity that has signed and issued the certificate. It SHALL comply with the applicable requirements of [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.2.3.2], as specified by the corresponding certificate profile. Section 4.1.2.4 validity SEQUENCE REQUIRED Represents the time interval during which the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d45456957b71996e654e8f0f3ba46a18: warrants that it will maintain information about the status of the certificate. Section 4.1.2.5 subject CHOICE REQUIRED Identifies the entity associated with the public key stored in the subject public key field. It SHALL comply with the applicable requirements of [ETSI EN 319 412-3, Clause 4.2.1], as specified by the corresponding certificate profile. Section 4.1.2.6 subjectPublicKeyInfo SEQUENCE REQUIRED Carries the public key and identifies the algorithm with which the key is used. The subject public key SHOULD be selected according to [ETSI TS 119 312] but MAY be superseded by national recommendations. Section 4.1.2.7 issuerUniqueID BIT STRING PROHIBITED Represents the issuer unique identifiers, to handle the possibility of reuse of issuer names over time. Section 4.1.2.8 subjectUniqueID BIT STRING PROHIBITED Represents the subject unique identifiers, to handle the possibility of reuse of subject names over time. Section 4.1.2.8 extensions SEQUENCE REQUIRED Contains a sequence of one or more certificate extensions conforming to the structure defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2]. The applicable extensions and their profile-specific constraints are defined below and in the corresponding certificate profile. Section 4.1.2.9

The following table specifies the X.509 certificate extensions supported by this specification, including their Object Identifiers (OIDs), type, criticality, description, and normative references. Individual certificate profiles SHALL define the presence requirement (REQUIRED, OPTIONAL, or PROHIBITED) for each extension and MAY further constrain its syntax and contents.

The criticality values used in this specification have the following meaning:

  • C: the extension SHALL be marked critical;
  • NC: the extension SHALL be marked non-critical.
Extension OID Type Criticality Description Reference authorityKeyIdentifier 2.5.29.35 SEQUENCE NC Identifies the public key corresponding to the private key used by the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:79841b7327436e376f2130bf286a11df: to sign the certificate. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.1], [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.3.1] subjectKeyIdentifier 2.5.29.14 OCTET STRING NC Identifies certificates that contain a particular public key. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2] keyUsage 2.5.29.15 BIT STRING C Defines the purpose of the key contained in the certificate. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.3], [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.3.2], [ETSI EN 319 412-3, Clause 4.3.1] certificatePolicies 2.5.29.32 SEQUENCE NC Contains a sequence of one or more policy information terms. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.4], [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.3.3] subjectAltName 2.5.29.17 SEQUENCE NC Represents a set of possible alternative names for the subject of the certificate. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.6], [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.3.5], [ETSI TS 119 411-8, Clause 6.6.1, GEN-6.6.1-07] issuerAltName 2.5.29.18 SEQUENCE NC Represents a set of possible alternative names for the issuer of the certificate. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.7] basicConstraints 2.5.29.19 SEQUENCE C Identifies whether the subject of the certificate is a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c32539acc73d468bdc677a3d032ed75d: and the maximum depth of valid certification paths that include this certificate. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.9] cRLDistributionPoints 2.5.29.31 SEQUENCE NC Contains references to publicly available 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e2b44601cd2477f043be57e474a09d6c:. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.13], [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.3.11] authorityInfoAccess 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1 SEQUENCE NC Indicates how to access information and services for the issuer of the certificate. [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.2.1], [ETSI EN 319 412-2, Clause 4.4.1] ext-etsi-valassured-ST-certs 0.4.0.194121.2.1 NULL NC Indicates that the certificate issuer ensures the validity of the certificate is assured at time of use of the corresponding private key. Upon presence of such statement, the WRP can decide not to check the certificate revocation status. [ETSI EN 319 412-1, Clause 5.2.2] noRevAvail 2.5.29.56 NULL NC Allows a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:855ecef687d5c1ad3eb4ede924d99074: to indicate that no revocation information will be made available for this certificate. [RFC 9608, Section 2] qcStatements 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.3 SEQUENCE NC Contains a sequence of one or more objects to define explicit properties of the certificate. [RFC 3739, Section 3.2.6], [ETSI EN 319 412-5, Clause 4.2]

Preventing Circular Dependencies in URIs

To prevent circular validation dependencies during TLS handshakes, URIs defined in the cRLDistributionPoints and authorityInfoAccess extensions SHALL use the http:// scheme instead of https:// as suggested by [RFC 5280, Section 8].

docs.title: Wallet-Relying Party Access Certificate
docs.text:
This section extends the general X.509 Certificate Profile and specifies a Certificate Profile for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b7c83d2b420abeb86f253baa76aead50:.

According to [CIR 2025/848, Article 2], a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:50c5e6af027233c48ac358c074a59792: is a certificate for electronic seals or signatures authenticating and validating the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7d74d814c957477fc35cde52a0be3505:<__None__> when they interact with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a674ad0b67df9a33915c197d4dde8a76:<__None__>. For more details on the authentication process, see Authentication Process.

The suspension or cancellation of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:3e8fe2dc5ff35974ca9ea44ae5adf439: services involves revocation of all valid 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f0a17e5f2c54b2ca06093314a2c869f8: by the relevant issuing authority, such that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:52e84b62ef2b8e92e0e84b5797c81e45: is no longer able to interact with 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:2f056d23c19bea3c12cfc31d875d8818:. For more detail on the Trust Management processes, see Trust Management and Lifecycle. References

The technical standard specific to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:04bd63f4ecf627d980a59d9572b4aba9: is [ETSI TS 119 411-8]. However, multiple other standards are referenced either directly or indirectly by [ETSI TS 119 411-8], containing requirements that are applicable to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c4ea62da784726b856a51213316b7b8e: as well. The list below enumerates all the applicable standards and specifications that have been used to populate the table below:

  • CIR 2025/848
  • ETSI EN 319 411-1
  • ETSI EN 319 411-2 (applicable if the certificate is qualified)
  • ETSI EN 319 412-1
  • ETSI EN 319 412-3 (applicable if the certificate is issued to legal persons)
  • ETSI EN 319 412-5 (applicable if the certificate is qualified)
  • ETSI TS 119 411-8
  • RFC 3647
  • RFC 3739
  • RFC 5280
  • RFC 9608

Dependency Considerations

The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5a263efe48d0070d6964a280a5874e65: attributes SHALL be derived from the information held in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d3ae58494de38b8637863e6c924a2113:<__None__> as specified in [ETSI TS 119 475, Clause 5.1.2]. This also implies that for some specific attributes in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c1fb8ebbe91bd69b2c2037b503ce61b5: the same value SHALL be encountered in the corresponding 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c05b681056f964a41671bec7254cf007: if any.

The following table defines the complete set of extensions applicable to the certificate profile. Extensions not listed in the table SHALL NOT be present.

Extension Presence Notes authorityKeyIdentifier REQUIRED The value of the keyIdentifier field SHOULD be derived from the public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.1]. subjectKeyIdentifier OPTIONAL If present, its value SHOULD be derived from the subject public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2]. keyUsage REQUIRED It SHALL contain one (and only one) of the key-usage settings Type A, Type B, or Type F. Type A SHOULD be used as per [ETSI EN 319 412-3, LEG-4.3.1-4]. certificatePolicies REQUIRED It SHALL include a PolicyInformation structure with policyIdentifier set to one of the following values (defined in [ETSI TS 119 411-8]): 0.4.0.194118.1.1 (NCP-n-eudiwrp); 0.4.0.194118.1.2 (NCP-l-eudiwrp); 0.4.0.194118.1.3 (QCP-n-eudiwrp); 0.4.0.194118.1.4 (QCP-l-eudiwrp). Moreover, policyQualifiers SHALL contain a cpsURI that references an URL where the CPS of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a58b9b49ad7c02f88708fea0e859de64: is located. subjectAltName REQUIRED It SHALL include a GeneralName structure with one of the following parameters defined to provide valid contact information of the WRP: uniformResourceIdentifier (website for helpdesk/support matters), otherName with type-id set to 2.5.4.20 (id-at-telephoneNumber, phone number for WRP registration/usage matters), rfc822Name (email address for WRP registration/usage matters). cRLDistributionPoints CONDITIONAL REQUIRED IF: the certificate does not include any access location of an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb5e5dfc0df5b807ce435d82c9572fa4: responder or the validity assured extension as defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-1]. If present, it SHALL contain at least one reference to a publicly available 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d82bd882b44277fe625bbf3118e2c270:. authorityInfoAccess REQUIRED It SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2 (id-ad-caIssuers) and accessLocation specifying at least one access location of a valid CA certificate of the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5b03afb6d2e0d9dfb1fc7842f8c731cc:. If 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:37c0445ba14b6bcd941ce2fef3dfafa8: is supported by the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:10916eefb36684945b09b57b1ef4a896:, the extension SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1 (id-ad-ocsp) and accessLocation specifying at least one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb250a129afc0f54a917b3ce0c04434d: responder authoritative to provide certificate status information for the certificate. qcStatements OPTIONAL It MAY contain QCStatement structures among those defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-5, Clause 4.2]. In any case, it SHALL NOT contain:
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-1.
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.4 (id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-4.
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.7 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCClegislation), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-7.

APTITUDE Implementation Choices

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cb3b0b83d469e1e233c5b6b352d708a1: SHALL be issued only to legal persons.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b2a9421420d5fc4097b655bfbd409d2c: SHALL be long-lived. Therefore, the extensions ext-etsi-valassured-ST-certs and noRevAvail SHALL NOT be specified.
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9d5e81507f6b73f82e3224835b188ae7: SHALL NOT be Qualified Certificates. Therefore, the qcStatements extension SHALL NOT contain QCStatement structures with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance) or 0.4.0.1862.1.4 (id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD). Example: WRPAC 

    AccessCertificate cert = {
  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x6F3A0B91D2...",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL
    },

    issuer: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "IT",
      organizationName: "Example Trust Services CA",
      commonName: "Example CA",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATIT-123456789"
    },

    validity: {
      notBefore: Time.utcTime("260127000000Z"),
      notAfter: Time.utcTime("270127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "IT",
      organizationName: "Relying Party Example S.p.A.",
      commonName: "Relying Party Example",
      organizationIdentifier: "LEIXG-5493001KJTIIGC8Y1R12"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "HEX(20B_KEYID_OF_ISSUING_CA_PUBLIC_KEY)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage
        critical: true,
        value: KeyUsage {
          nonRepudiation: true                            // Type A
          // All other bits set to false
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.32",                                 // certificatePolicies
        critical: false,
        value: CertificatePolicies [
          PolicyInformation {
            policyIdentifier: "0.4.0.194118.1.2",         // NCP-l-eudiwrp
            policyQualifiers: [
              CPSuri("https://rpca.example.test/cps")
            ]
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.17",                                 // subjectAltName
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectAltName [
          GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("https://rp.example.test/support"),
          GeneralName.rfc822Name("support@rp.example.test"),
          GeneralName.otherName(
            type-id: "2.5.4.20",                          // id-at-telephoneNumber
            value: "+420111222333"
          )
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.31",                                 // cRLDistributionPoints
        critical: false,
        value: CRLDistributionPoints [
          DistributionPoint {
            distributionPoint: DistributionPointName.fullName([
              GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://crl.example.test/issuing-ca.crl")
            ])
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1",                         // authorityInfoAccess
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityInfoAccess [
          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2",           // id-ad-caIssuers
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ca.example.test/caIssuers/issuing-ca.cer")
          },

          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1",           // id-ad-ocsp
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ocsp.example.test")
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },

  signatureAlgorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
    oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                         // SHALL match/align with tbsCertificate.signature
    params: NULL
  },

  signatureValue: "BASE64(SIGN(issuerPrivateKey, DER(tbsCertificate)))"
}

    Security Considerations

    As the private key corresponding to the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb9ab2eaf10fc8123cc4c4619ac56e34: is a signature/seal key, implementations SHALL prevent the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e75beee460b0c3c598a3b863af9acb2e: key from becoming a general-purpose signing oracle.

    SC-1 — No blind signing of attacker-controlled inputs.

    The 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f4d2dd0e0b605aa29c13e667f0708222: (and any remote signing component used on its behalf, e.g., HSM/QSCD/remote seal) should only sign well-defined, locally constructed protocol artifacts and should not sign arbitrary bytes received from outside (e.g., random 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0014e91f4dd72f6a86bb86f0716f9494:, hashes, or opaque challenges supplied by an attacker). For instance, when the interaction with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4efcf641d8d90571f618fae7164e6d65:<__None__> takes plase as described in [OpenID4VP], the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cd1e8a824f5cccccf114c352c54e4343: signs a self-constructed 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:484cd74b7d1378bc475c41c485bcc32e:<__None__>. Before signing, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1230c496ba236454fde4bc42020afd00: SHOULD validate that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:6323b3fa6a6dba94173bf8ed6de99ad9:<__None__> is fully context-bound (e.g., correct aud, client_id/iss, exp, nonce, and correct endpoint binding such as response_uri/redirect_uri, and the intended presentation definition). Any signing API should enforce a strict schema/allowlist and reject unexpected fields. This is particularly important when the key usage is set to non-repudiation, since this protects against the signing entity falsely denying some action and allows a reliable third party to determine the authenticity of signed data in case of later conflict.

    SC-2 — Bind signatures to the intended protocol context.

    Signed protocol objects should be clearly typed and scoped to the protocol to reduce cross-context misuse. In particular:

    • Use an explicit JOSE typ value appropriate for secured authorization requests / OpenID4VP 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:85a229df62dbad83992abd4883a6f5bf:.
    • Constrain accepted JOSE algorithms and key types, and reject insecure or unexpected values (e.g., alg=none).

      • SC-3 — Key protection, access control, and monitoring.

      Private keys corresponding to 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e1412f26a13670cf57db152c472c7fe3: SHOULD be protected and operated under strong controls (access control for key use, audit logging, incident response, and operational monitoring). For remote signing, apply rate limiting and anomaly detection to reduce abuse.

docs.title: Entity Sign/Seal Certificate
docs.text:
This section extends the X.509 Certificate Profile and specifies Certificate Profiles for Entity Sign/Seal Certificates, which are used for signing and sealing various 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b6d61df55cca8857b4654579967bf947:. References

To guarantee the interoperability across all entities of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1cfbcd2564b34170460db197f57e064b:<__None__> ecosystem, Entity Sign/Seal Certificates should adhere to common requirements, with respect to their content and format. The technical specifications describing such content are distributed between multiple documents and for a purpose of proper referencing are listed below:

  • ETSI EN 319 411-1
  • ETSI EN 319 411-2 (applicable if the certificate is qualified)
  • ETSI EN 319 412-1
  • ETSI EN 319 412-2 (applicable if the certificate is issued to natural persons)
  • ETSI EN 319 412-3 (applicable if the certificate is issued to legal persons)
  • ETSI EN 319 412-5 (applicable if the certificate is qualified)
  • ETSI TS 119 412-6 (profiles the Sign/Seal certificate for various entities in the EUDI Wallet ecosystem)
  • ETSI TS 119 612
  • RFC 3986
  • RFC 5280

APTITUDE Implementation Choices

  • Entity Sign/Seal Certificates SHALL be issued by a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7b33742d26e8653733f8ed68c5862b10: and SHALL NOT be self-signed.
  • Entity Sign/Seal Certificates SHALL be issued only to legal persons.
  • Entity Sign/Seal Certificates SHALL be long-lived. Therefore, the extensions ext-etsi-valassured-ST-certs and noRevAvail SHALL NOT be specified.

docs.title: PID Provider Sign/Seal Certificate
docs.text:

The following table defines the complete set of extensions applicable to the certificate profile. Extensions not listed in the table SHALL NOT be present.

Extension Presence Notes authorityKeyIdentifier REQUIRED The value of the keyIdentifier field SHOULD be derived from the public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.1] subjectKeyIdentifier OPTIONAL If present, its value be derived from the subject public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2]. keyUsage REQUIRED certificatePolicies REQUIRED As described in [ETSI EN 319 411-2, Clause 6.6.1]. subjectAltName REQUIRED cRLDistributionPoints CONDITIONAL REQUIRED IF: the certificate does not include any access location of an 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8ed3bc57f17ec3b49a1174b567c5fb34: responder or the validity assured extension as defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-1]. If present, it SHALL contain at least one reference to a publicly available 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88f6dd2433303aa50bd36d2e5c5c6115:. authorityInfoAccess REQUIRED It SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2 (id-ad-caIssuers) and accessLocation specifying at least one access location of a valid CA certificate of the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7fa79312d3c133b54e3c4d456cace8c8:. If 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:be2727ad60002b16b3be71e08312af29: is supported by the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:ec829df93d70da3e100af18db1390bbd:, the extension SHALL include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1 (id-ad-ocsp) and accessLocation specifying at least one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0946e821fee8ba0f1a876ffb67ef7a60: responder authoritative to provide certificate status information for the certificate, as described in Online Certificate Status Protocol. qcStatements REQUIRED It SHALL contain:
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-1.
  • A QCStatement structure with statementId set to the OID corresponding to id-etsi-qcs-QcPSB; the corresponding statementInfo SHALL contain a QcPSB structure including the fields defined in [ETSI TS 119 412-6, Clause 8.3].
It MAY contain additional QCStatement structures among those defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-5, Clause 4.2]. In any case, it SHALL NOT contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.7 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCClegislation), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-7.

Warning

While the specific requirements for 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9cd94e2eb83894e10f00b773bc456b18: Sign/Seal Certificates specified in [ETSI TS 119 412-6, Clause 8] do not require these certificates to be qualified, [EU REG 2024/1183, Art. 45f(1)(b)] requires 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:eb431899fce44503d5997842fcc4438e: to be signed with a qualified certificate.

APTITUDE Implementation Choice

To comply with [EU REG 2024/1183, Art. 45f(1)(b)], although not explicitly required by [ARF] or [ETSI TS 119 412-6], 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:08600d7a410523f55a33206074406ab1: Sign/Seal Certificates are Qualified Certificates. Therefore, the qcStatements extension SHALL contain at least a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.1 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance).

Warning

[ETSI TS 119 412-6, Annex A] does not define the specific OID of the id-etsi-qcs-QcPSB statement identifier.

Example: Pub-EAA Provider Sign/Seal Certificate 

AccessCertificate cert = {
  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x6354A56B5D...",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL
    },

    issuer: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "IT",
      organizationName: "Example Trust Services CA",
      commonName: "Example CA",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATIT-123456789"
    },

    validity: {
      notBefore: Time.utcTime("260127000000Z"),
      notAfter: Time.utcTime("270127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "IT",
      organizationName: "Example of PuB-EAA Provider",
      commonName: "PuB-EAA Provider Example",
      organizationIdentifier: "LEIXG-5494201KJTIIGC8Y1R12"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "SHA-1(ISSUER_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.14",                                 // subjectKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectKeyIdentifier("SHA-1(SUBJECT_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)")
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage
        critical: true,
        value: KeyUsage {
          nonRepudiation: true                            // Type A
          // All other bits set to false
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.32",                                 // certificatePolicies
        critical: false,
        value: CertificatePolicies [
          PolicyInformation {
            policyIdentifier: "0.4.0.194112.1.3",         // qcp-legal-qscd
            policyQualifiers: [
              CPSuri("https://rpca.example.test/cps")
            ]
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.17",                                 // subjectAltName
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectAltName [
          GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("https://pub-eaa.example.test/support"),
          GeneralName.rfc822Name("support@pub-eaa.example.test"),
          GeneralName.otherName(
            type-id: "2.5.4.20",                          // id-at-telephoneNumber
            value: "+420111222777"
          )
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.31",                                 // cRLDistributionPoints
        critical: false,
        value: CRLDistributionPoints [
          DistributionPoint {
            distributionPoint: DistributionPointName.fullName([
              GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://crl.example.test/issuing-ca.crl")
            ])
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1",                         // authorityInfoAccess
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityInfoAccess [
          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2",           // id-ad-caIssuers
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ca.example.test/caIssuers/issuing-ca.cer")
          },

          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1",           // id-ad-ocsp
            accessLocation: GeneralName.uniformResourceIdentifier("http://ocsp.example.test")
          }
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.3",                         // qcStatements
        critical: false,
        value: QCStatements [
          QCStatement {                                   // esi4-qcStatement-1
            statementId: "0.4.0.1862.1.1",                // id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance
          },

          QCStatement {                                   // esi4-qcStatement-4
            statementId: "0.4.0.1862.1.4",                // id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD
          },

          QCStatement {
            statementId: "TBD",                           // id-etsi-qcs-QcPSB (OID not yet defined)
            statementInfo: QcPSB {
              countryOfLegislation: "IT",
              authSourceIdentification: "https://www.anpr.interno.it",
              legislationIdentification: "https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/2005/05/16/005G0106/sg"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },

  signatureAlgorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
    oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                         // SHALL match/align with tbsCertificate.signature
    params: NULL
  },

  signatureValue: "BASE64(SIGN(issuerPrivateKey, DER(tbsCertificate)))"
}

docs.title: Trust Anchor Certificate
docs.text:
This section extends the general X.509 Certificate Profile and specifies a Certificate Profile for entity 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:45244f149d86684e194e4d84ff546e0a:.

A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c9cbda657ecc42f27fd32ff2c6ddf456:<__None__> is an authoritative entity represented by a public key and associated data. The public key is used to verify digital signatures, and the associated data is used to constrain the types of information or actions for which the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7c7882bc972c5bc3b800b574eb1702b3:<__None__> is authoritative. Within the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:54ba79e02adbd9cd2950e15720e1a058: infrastructure, the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:7e75347bd9c0dcdd9e51d30d655100f4:<__None__> Certificate is referenced from the corresponding service entry through the serviceDigitalIdentity component.

6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bb0d13e00f1847f538d31b2576df6102:<__None__> certificates MAY be self-signed or non self-signed. In any case, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:4963049edc60af6d1519f56d89d832e6: SHALL NOT require an additional issuer chain above a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e629db8d2e797f5e73c12934628ae6fa:-designated trust anchor, even if it is not self-signed, as the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:04318707cab5000be3db3e622139bb40:<__None__> is a trust-store input designated by policy.

Relationship Between Trust Anchors and Entity Sign/Seal Certificates

According to [OpenID4VC HAIP, Clause 6.1]:

  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0eb8e00c703cb146a928ba3d2ea9dbe7:'s signing certificate SHALL be present in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5660e76cb775a6f33517b2902975713f: x5c header (the x5c header SHALL NOT be empty).
  • 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:102d9e41deb0200756c407693b065ce7:<__None__> certificate of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:be3b09067108af16f62df25e6cb3800b: SHALL NOT be present in the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:21c213878e9ab10439def9d3d0855092: x5c header.

    Therefore, 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8afde773bec2fb998a05981143c03734:' Sign/Seal Certificates SHALL NOT be a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:85e9f421befe04977511815ef2d72f7a:<__None__> certificate. References

    • CIR 2024/2980
    • ETSI TS 119 602
    • ETSI TS 119 612
    • RFC 5280
    • RFC 5914

    APTITUDE Implementation Choice

    6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9de5fcf449009ed71adcd8b5d3df9317:<__None__> Certificates SHALL be issued only to legal persons.

    The following table defines the profile-specific requirements for the certificate fields. Fields not listed in the table remain subject to the requirements defined in the X.509 Certificate Profile.

    Field Additional Requirements issuer If the certificate is self-signed, the issuer's distinguished name SHALL be identical to the subject's distinguished name. Otherwise, the issuer's distinguished name SHALL identify the entity that signed and issued the certificate and MAY differ from the subject's distinguished name. subject The distinguished name SHALL contain an organizationName attribute identifying that entity.

    The following table defines the complete set of extensions applicable to the certificate profile.

    Extension Presence Notes authorityKeyIdentifier CONDITIONAL REQUIRED IF: the certificate is not self-signed. For self-signed certificates, it is RECOMMENDED. If the extension is present, the value of the keyIdentifier field SHOULD be derived from the public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.1]. subjectKeyIdentifier REQUIRED Provides a key identifier for the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0e7950c531526ca190ce153664bbf3e4:<__None__> public key. Its value SHOULD be derived from the subject public key using the methods defined in [RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.2]. This extension SHOULD support reliable Certificate Path construction and certificate matching in 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:decb6ac38ae7209f32b0858e09c2480b:-based deployments. keyUsage REQUIRED It SHALL assert the keyCertSign bit. It MAY assert the cRLSign bit if the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:8bef51f512da74603ae833193b0cc007:<__None__> certificate is used by the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f881d9ab49767ed6396a32110eb80c0e: to sign 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:cf52973e257de11cb7dce50c920d132e:. It SHOULD be limited to usages consistent with the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b46abee07cf71fde504818a1798d6550: role of the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1fc4c1e16938a7ce563a0b58573d65a9:<__None__> certificate. certificatePolicies OPTIONAL It MAY include a PolicyInformation structure relevant to the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f9a8879190959446fa6084f1428b45e6:'s practices. subjectAltName OPTIONAL It MAY include a GeneralName structure with additional information on the subject. issuerAltName OPTIONAL It MAY include a GeneralName structure with additional information on the issuer. basicConstraints REQUIRED The cA field SHALL be set to TRUE, signalling 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:aac94a03494256e1476ec83816c99e34: capability for X.509 path validation. The pathLenConstraint field MAY be present; in that case, it SHALL limit the number of non-self-issued intermediate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:54af3af9e87637fbd99aab84a9989653: certificates below the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:011c1f072e460a74b515f00a24e4c818:<__None__>. It is RECOMMENDED to set pathLenConstraint to 0 to prevent subordinate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e9913cc32368b7188684d318732275b6: layers, unless a documented operational need exists to support additional intermediate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c770693d1d6326a1759a40bf7f4d75d7: tiers. cRLDistributionPoints OPTIONAL It MAY include 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:fb28e27fcffdb315c0b1b2c321afbdee: distribution point URIs, when 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:94cb72eae972b323463ad01c7c836d93:-based revocation is used. authorityInfoAccess OPTIONAL If applicable, it MAY include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2 (id-ad-caIssuers) and an accessLocation specifying at least one access location of a valid 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:d877e0b172af0a54a1e437be88bff8a8: certificate of the issuing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c7003a32b2f6800f72fc5b50bbb56919:.It MAY also include an AccessDescription structure with accessMethod set to 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.1 (id-ad-ocsp) and accessLocation specifying at least one 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5fc0a979a502e3f111f1ed8023f452f2: responder authoritative to provide certificate status information for the certificate, when 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:0039f39b480cc7a3116330da5b85be45:-based revocation is used. qcStatements OPTIONAL It MAY contain QCStatement structures among those defined in [ETSI EN 319 412-5, Clause 4.2]. In any case, it SHALL NOT contain a QCStatement structure with statementId set to 0.4.0.1862.1.7 (id-etsi-qcs-QcCClegislation), referred to as esi4-qcStatement-7.

    Note

    The pathLenConstraint restricts the depth of certification paths below the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5c573337166ad9ff72faa4e6cef602dc:<__None__>, as follows:

    • A value of 0 means that the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1fbf8f82981dd642015ba27714670237:<__None__> MAY issue end-entity certificates but SHALL NOT allow additional non-self-issued intermediate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5be4888a609a54bce142a3242aa7ec33: certificates in the path.
    • Absence of the pathLenConstraint implies that no explicit limit is imposed by the certificate itself.

      • This profile allows the field to be OPTIONAL to support interoperability with different 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:79ccce7173ebebd69a39b3aa90b0cd5c: deployment models. However, setting pathLenConstraint to 0 is RECOMMENDED to reduce trust hierarchy complexity, improve predictability of certificate chains, and limit the risk associated with unintended subordinate certification authorities.

      Use Case-Specific Requirements

      Specific Use Cases could have custom 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:1aa7ce216b9aad3f5e875334bb63fb80:<__None__> Certificate requirements. Where strictly necessary, implementations MAY define and support additional extensions beyond the profile defined above.

      Example: Self-signed Entity Trust Anchor (root-style) 

      AccessCertificate trustAnchor = {
  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x9D846F726A8..",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL
    },

    issuer: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor CA",
      commonName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor Root",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-127263789"
    },

    validity: {
      notBefore: Time.utcTime("260127000000Z"),
      notAfter: Time.utcTime("310127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {                          // SHALL match the Issuer
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor CA",
      commonName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor Root",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-127263789"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "SHA-1(ISSUER_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.14",                                 // subjectKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectKeyIdentifier("SHA-1(SUBJECT_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)")
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage
        critical: true,
        value: KeyUsage {
          keyCertSign: true,
          cRLSign: true
          // All other bits set to false
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.19",                                 // basicConstraints
        critical: true,
        value: BasicConstraints {
          cA: true,
          pathLenConstraint: 0
        }
      }      
    ]
  },

  signatureAlgorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
    oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                         // SHALL match/align with tbsCertificate.signature
    params: NULL
  },

  signatureValue: "BASE64(SIGN(issuerPrivateKey, DER(tbsCertificate)))"
}

      Example: Non-self-signed Entity Trust Anchor (pinned intermediate CA)

  tbsCertificate: {
    version: 2,                                           // Integer value 2 for v3
    serialNumber: "0x736A63D6352..",

    signature: AlgorithmIdentifier {
      oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.11",                       // sha256WithRSAEncryption
      params: NULL
    },

    issuer: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example Root CA",
      commonName: "Example Root",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-987654321"
    },

    validity: {
      notBefore: Time.utcTime("260127000000Z"),
      notAfter: Time.utcTime("270127000000Z")
    },

    subject: DistinguishedName {
      countryName: "CZ",
      organizationName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor CA",
      commonName: "Example Entity Trust Anchor (Pinned Intermediate)",
      organizationIdentifier: "VATCZ-123481789"
    },

    subjectPublicKeyInfo: {
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {
        oid: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1",                      // rsaEncryption
        params: NULL
      },

      subjectPublicKey: "BASE64(SPKI_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES)"
    },

    extensions: [
      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.35",                                 // authorityKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityKeyIdentifier {
          keyIdentifier: "SHA-1(ISSUER_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)"
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.14",                                 // subjectKeyIdentifier
        critical: false,
        value: SubjectKeyIdentifier("SHA-1(SUBJECT_PUBLIC_KEY_VALUE)")
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.15",                                 // keyUsage
        critical: true,
        value: KeyUsage {
          keyCertSign: true
          // All other bits set to false
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.18",                                 // issuerAltName

          GeneralName.rfc822Name("info@root-ca.example.test")
        ]
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "2.5.29.19",                                 // basicConstraints
        critical: true,
        value: BasicConstraints {
          cA: true,
          pathLenConstraint: 0
        }
      },

      Extension {
        oid: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1",                         // authorityInfoAccess
        critical: false,
        value: AuthorityInfoAccess [
          AccessDescription {
            accessMethod: "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.48.2",           // id-ad-caIssuers

          }

      }
    ]
  },

  signatureAlgorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier {

    params: NULL
  },

  signatureValue: "BASE64(SIGN(issuerPrivateKey, DER(tbsCertificate)))"
}

docs.title: Register
docs.text:
A 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:26ef1c727a7f58a828d60208114710dc:<__None__> is the designated body that:

  • Manages the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c05571892eb232303b4932f2dc254454: registration lifecycle (onboarding, update, suspension, cancellation);
  • Ensures the integrity and publication of registration information;
  • Ensures interoperability by exposing 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:e612227edbd4cec0851524f239fd6e5d: registration data via a national website and a single common REST API.

    The national 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:b6e5116671d88a90d8e116bfb7f81325:<__None__> of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:20da2d24d56d107e6b1365122e005a7b: is the publicly accessible system (dataset + API) that provides signed/sealed registration statements about 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:25c6e1e37003d80ac7fd250d88acec5c: and their authorizations/declared usage.

    Note

    The national 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a3149fe815c7945798c86dfda44bd585:<__None__> of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:a2790927e5f19b38117aadcf8e8e9c69: is a single logical register. For scalability and resilience, a Member State MAY deploy multiple technical instances provided they expose a single coherent common REST API and return signed statements as required.

    Additionally, sectorial registers may exist internally, but the decision regarding issuance of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:bf4863078f3e07667437abc7c06be07c: is solely based on whether the 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:9d037b35fdbf82ac8136817d18508fdb: has been registered with an active status in the national 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:004d8674b45a162507ec5fa462070c06:<__None__>. References

docs.title: Register Requirements
docs.text:
ID Requirement Reference REGISTER-PUB-01 Each Member State SHALL establish and maintain at least one national Register of WRPs. [CIR 2025/848, Article 3(1)] REGISTER-PUB-02 The Register SHALL include at least the information set out in Annex I of [CIR 2025/848]. [CIR 2025/848, Article 3(2)] REGISTER-PUB-03 Member States SHALL designate at least one Registrar to manage and operate at least one national Register. [CIR 2025/848, Article 3(3)] REGISTER-PUB-04 Member States SHALL make Annex I information publicly available online in human-readable and machine-processable form. [CIR 2025/848, Article 3(4)] REGISTER-PUB-05 Annex I information included in the Register (as for REGISTER-PUB-02) SHALL be available through a national website and a single common API, and SHALL be electronically signed/sealed by/on behalf of the Registrar. [CIR 2025/848, Article 3(5)] REGISTER-API-01 The single common API SHALL be a REST API supporting JSON, and signed according to [RFC 7515]. [CIR 2025/848, Annex II §2(1)(a)] REGISTER-API-02 The API SHALL allow any requestor, without prior authentication, to search and request complete lists, allowing partial matches on defined parameters. [CIR 2025/848, Annex II §2(1)(b)] REGISTER-API-03 Replies to request that match at least one WRP SHALL include statements covering Annex I information [CIR 2025/848], current/historic WRPACs and WRPRCs, excluding Annex I point 4 information. [CIR 2025/848, Annex II §2(1)(c)] REGISTER-API-04 The API SHALL be published as OpenAPI v3 with documentation enabling interoperability across the Union. [CIR 2025/848, Annex II §2(1)(d)] REGISTER-API-05 The API SHALL provide security-by-default and by-design to ensure availability and integrity. [CIR 2025/848, Annex II §2(1)(e)] REGISTER-API-06 Statements referred to in REGISTER-API-03 SHALL be electronically signed/sealed JSON files as for [RFC 7515]. [CIR 2025/848, Annex II §2(2)]

Note

The set of 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:88dd79f4ae82c396d1346e3bf199bc1d: information listed in Annex I of [CIR 2025/848] and mentioned in REGISTER-PUB-05 and REGISTER-API-03 will be described in the Register Data Schema section.

[CIR 2025/848, Article 6(1)] REGISTRAR-REG-02 WRPs SHALL provide at least Annex I information to national registers. [CIR 2025/848, Article 6(3)] REGISTRAR-REG-05 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:38187938a49834fe00949d55ee7bc101: SHALL verify against supporting documentation or appropriate 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:66550fb698fcbc19aabf8e867556115c:/official records. [CIR 2025/848, Article 6(4)] REGISTRAR-REG-06 Verification of entitlements SHALL be carried out according to Annex III of [CIR 2025/848]. [CIR 2025/848, Article 6(5)] REGISTRAR-REG-07 If Registrar cannot verify according to Article 6(3)–(5) of [CIR 2025/848], Registrar SHALL reject the registration. [CIR 2025/848, Article 6(6)] REGISTRAR-GOV-01 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c66372e8cfd86a84be05765392d84ad9: SHALL suspend/cancel a registration of a WRP where requested by a 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:5d4df8d95ef3e518edfbc20e60d58150: (per eIDAS reference). [CIR 2025/848, Article 9(1)] REGISTRAR-GOV-02 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:f9e4c9bfee9702ac36aca628d164e665: MAY suspend/cancel a registration of a WRP if info inaccurate/outdated/misleading, non-compliance, excessive attribute requests, breach of law. [CIR 2025/848, Article 9(2)] REGISTRAR-GOV-03 6251a85a-47d0-11ee-be56-0242ac120002:c0e9ac520d87ebf05f6068148611219e: SHALL suspend/cancel a registration of a WRP if requested by the WRP itself. [CIR 2025/848, Article 9(3)] REGISTRAR-GOV-04 Registrar SHALL conduct proportionality assessment before suspension/cancellation under Article 9(2). [CIR 2025/848, Article 9(4)] REGISTRAR-GOV-05 Registrar SHALL notify WRP and relevant Providers of WRPAC and WRPRC without undue delay and not later than 24 hours. [CIR 2025/848, Article 9(5)] REGISTRAR-GOV-06 Providers of WRPAC and WRPRC SHALL revoke affected certificates without undue delay after notification (where applicable).
